facts.fact: The Institut National de la Statistique (INS), the national statistics office, officially launched data.gouv.cd on 2026-02-23, described as the national open data platform of the DRC and framed as part of the Government's vision for transparency; the document names no open data policy, strategy or decree behind it, so it does not tie the portal to a policy.

The INS releases datasets on data.gouv.cd covering demography, economy, health, education, public finance, agriculture and infrastructure in CSV, XLSX and JSON; the document gives no count of datasets or of publishing bodies and names no ministry other than the INS.
